Reference lane includes obvious large-cap demand/procurement beneficiaries such as Vertiv and Constellation. Discovery lane emphasizes investable chokepoint suppliers one or two steps away from the headline AI story: transmission-line hardware and nuclear fuel/enrichment. Claims are constrained to the provided search evidence; unsupported sizing and exposure details are labeled as inference or hypothesis. Expanded the AI/data-center power-load node into a focused underfollowed universe of scarce physical and regulated-grid enablers. The strongest Layer 1B discovery candidates are not hyperscalers or generation owners, but suppliers of transmission hardware, switchgear, metal coatings for grid/data-center infrastructure, and utility grid-edge software/data. These names plausibly benefit if AI data-center load growth forces faster procurement of interconnection equipment, substations, distribution gear, transmission upgrades, forecasting tools, and power-quality systems. This is research support only, not a trading recommendation. Expanded the underfollowed discovery lane around AI/data-center electricity demand by looking one to two steps away from obvious hyperscalers and mega-cap electrical equipment leaders. The strongest small/mid-cap discovery candidates from the provided evidence are transmission-line hardware, nuclear fuel/enrichment, domestic uranium feedstock, and specialized nuclear components/fuel-fabrication exposure.
